text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Listen to my beautiful laugh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I've got my beautiful-as-a-rose voice back, and just in time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Rose Stakes. Seeking the Pearl irritated her throat after eating too much spicy food, but it thankfully didn't take long for her to recover.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: 1,800 meters… Is there anything I need to watch out for at this distance?
choice_data_list: Just be careful about keeping your pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she goes all-out right from the start, she'll have a hard time making it through to the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that's actually the only thing I'm worried about. If she conserves her energy and times her final spurt right, she should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay! I won't go too fast. The pace for this race should be slower than a G1 too…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My potential has finally peaked with the coming of fall, and I'm going to make today a leisurely day to enjoy it all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? Why, who is that over there? Haha. Seems someone is interested in me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Keep an eye on me today, Dober. I'm going to be your biggest rival at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl… It's been a while, but she looks awfully confident.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well then, show me what you can do at this distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under the watchful eye of Mejiro Dober, the warm-up race for the Shuka Sho begins.
